sentence_1_it: Mio nipote era scusato per via della sua giovinezza.
sentence_1_en: My nephew was excused because of his youth.
sentence_2_it: Molti grandi uomini affrontarono grandi difficoltà durante la loro giovinezza.
sentence_2_en: Many great men went through hardship during their youth.
sentence_3_it: Le piacerebbe tornare ai giorni della sua giovinezza.
sentence_3_en: She would love to go back to the days of her youth.
